profileEvidence.summary: A working pursuit hound, the Turkish Greyhound is kept for hunting quail, partridge, rabbits and foxes in central and southern Anatolia. Locally called Tazi, it is especially associated with Konya and Şanlıurfa, including wetland hunting grounds. Smaller local populations have also been documented from Kars and Iğdır to Ankara and Istanbul.
profileEvidence.shortDescription: A Turkish pursuit hound with a varied hunting repertoire, rooted especially in Konya and Şanlıurfa’s local Tazi populations.
